description: Overview dashboard of argo-workflows-mixin (https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json), adapted: cluster variable and filters removed (single cluster, no cluster label), variables read from argo_workflows_gauge with All = .*, fixed datasource, homelab annotations, reading guide. options.content:
Overview dashboard of **argo-workflows-mixin** (adinhodovic, commit c331414; the mixin also ships the alerts used
in argo-workflows-raw). It targets the v3.6+/v4 metric names, which match v4.1.6. Variables: `namespace`/`job` =
the controller's scrape, `workflow_namespace` = where workflows run (`exported_namespace`). Panels built on
`argo_workflows_total_count`, `pod_pending_count`, `pod_restarts_total`, `pod_missing` and the CronWorkflow counters
start empty: those counters appear after the first event handled by the current controller Pod. Curated view with
queues, API, archive DB: **Argo Workflows / Operations**.

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

targets.expr: ALERTS{alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor", alertstate=~"firing|pending", namespace=~"argo-workflows"}

panels.description: Number of workflows currently in Pending or Running. This is the main at-a-glance workload indicator for the cluster. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Active Workflows

panels.description: Number of workflows currently in Failed or Error. Any sustained non-zero value deserves investigation. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Unhealthy Workflows

panels.description: Number of workflows that reached a terminal phase in the past 6 hours. Use this to gauge recent throughput. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Workflow Completions [6h]

panels.description: Percentage of completed workflows succeeding over the past 6 hours. No data means no completed workflows in that window. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Success Rate [6h]

panels.description: Number of workflow-created pods currently running. Compare with running workflows to assess parallelism. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Running Pods

panels.description: Number of workflows currently in the Pending phase. A high count may indicate resource constraints, scheduling issues, or parallelism limits. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Pending Workflows

panels.description: Distribution of currently active workflows across phases (Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed, Error). A healthy system shows mostly Running and Succeeded workflows. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Current Workflows by Phase

panels.description: Distribution of workflow completions by phase over the past 6 hours. High proportions of Failed or Error phases indicate systemic issues. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Workflow Completions by Phase [6h]

panels.description: Namespaces with the most Failed or Error workflow completions over the past 6 hours. This highlights problem areas without drilling into the table first. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Failed/Error Workflows by Namespace [6h]

panels.description: Distribution of workflow-created pods across phases. High Pending counts may indicate scheduling issues or resource constraints. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Current Pods by Phase

panels.description: Workflow completions by workflow namespace over the past 6 hours, including succeeded, failed, error, and derived success rate. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Workflow Overview by Namespace [6h]

panels.description: Number of workflows in each phase over time. Rising Pending counts indicate bottlenecks. Spikes in Running may indicate batch submissions. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Current Workflows by Phase

panels.description: Workflows reaching each terminal phase within each interval. This shows throughput and where recent workflow outcomes are landing. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Workflow Completions by Phase

panels.description: Percentage of workflows completing successfully over each dashboard rate interval. Drops below expected levels indicate workflow logic errors, infrastructure issues, or resource constraints. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Workflow Success Rate

panels.description: Duration of workflow reconciliation operations. Rising latency indicates controller overload, API server slowness, or complex workflow processing. P99 spikes precede visible degradation. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Workflow Operation Duration

panels.description: Number of workflow-created pods in each phase over time. Rising Pending pods indicate scheduling issues or resource constraints. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Current Pods by Phase

panels.description: Pods entering pending state within each interval, grouped by reason. Helps identify scheduling or resource issues behind pod backlog. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Pending Pods by Reason

panels.description: Pod restarts within each interval, grouped by reason. Persistent restarts indicate infrastructure instability. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Pod Restarts by Reason

panels.description: Pods reported missing within each interval. Spikes may indicate aggressive eviction, node failure, or resource pressure. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: Missing Pods

panels.description: CronWorkflow triggers within each interval. Use this to verify scheduled workflows are firing as expected. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
panels.title: CronWorkflow Triggers

panels.description: CronWorkflow concurrency policy actions within each interval. Use this to spot schedules being affected by `Forbid` or `Replace` policy behavior. (Upstream panel from argo-workflows-mixin; source: https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/blob/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152/dashboards_out/argo-workflows-overview.json.)
